messages.subject: Saving packages via Winstat
parts:
I am a sociology student and would like to download a package called
MatchIt to R. I'm new to R. The problem is that the default
directory location is in the C drive and I do not have privileges to
download stuff to the C drive.

Does anyone know how to change the directory location for dowloaded
packages?

Thanks,
Steven

messages.author: 963b6d84a823404f
messages.subject: Re: Saving packages via Winstat

You can install a package elsewhere. See question 4.2 in the R for
Windows FAQ:
http://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/rw-FAQ.html

karl

messages.author: 963b6d84a823404f
messages.subject: Building packages for Windows
parts:
At the Madison R user group meeting today, I promised I'd send links
regarding building R packages for Windows. It's not hard; you just
need to assemble a few tools.

The official page that describes things:
http://www.murdoch-sutherland.com/Rtools/

My own description:
http://www.biostat.wisc.edu/~kbroman/Rintro/Rwinpack.html

A description of the tools, from the R-admin manual:
http://cran.r-project.org/doc/manuals/R-admin.html#The-Windows-toolset

An alternative for your own packages is to submit the package to the
win-builder.R-project.org site. It will build the package and run the
package checks then send email to whoever is listed in the DESCRIPTION
file as the maintainer with a link to the results.

Especially for those of us who don't use Windows and find the steps
required under Windows to be unnecessarily it is wonderful. If you
have the fortunes package installed you should check

fortune("installing")
